title: Crestbound
short_description: Crestbound — a third-person analog 3D platformer. Run, triple-jump, long-jump, wall-kick and ground-pound through four realms of open courses, hunting seven Crests in every one.
description:
CRESTBOUND is a third-person platformer built around the thing those games live or die on: how it feels to move.

Nim runs on an analog curve — ease the stick to walk, push it all the way to run — and turns tight when slow, wide when fast. Land and jump again to chain a higher one, then a third with a flip. Crouch at speed for a long jump that stays low and fast. Crouch from a stand for a backflip. Reverse and jump for a sideflip. Dive into a belly slide and cancel it with a hop. Kick off a wall, ground-pound through a crate, slide a steep slope and jump out of it, swim, climb a pole. Nothing floats: the jump apex arrives in a third of a second, and the camera never fights you mid-flight.

The Keep is a real place, not a menu. Walk its hall, its basement, its upstairs wing and its courtyard, and step into a painting to enter a course. Every course is an open diorama with multiple routes, hidden lines and a set-piece — a hill fort with a chained Gnasher, a foundry of sinking slag and piston halls, a frozen village and a glacier chute, a flooded temple, a clockwork tower, and a rainbow road above the clouds.

Seven Crests hide in every course, and each one is a different kind of challenge: one out in the open for whoever routes well, eight Sigils on the risky lines, a hundred coins, a secret behind something you have to break, a Warden to outfight, a race against the clock, and a power hat.

Checkpoints are frequent, death rewinds the last moments and puts you back in well under a second, and the hazards run on a fixed clock — so the gauntlet that killed you presents exactly the same timing on the next attempt. You learn it, then you beat it.
controls_keyboard: WASD move (tap = walk, hold = run) · SPACE jump (tap again on landing to chain a double, then a triple) · CTRL/C crouch · CTRL+SPACE at speed = long jump · CTRL+SPACE from a stand = backflip · F dive · CTRL in the air = ground pound · SPACE on a wall = wall kick · Q/E orbit camera · Z recenter · G first-person peek · E talk/interact · R restart course · T back to checkpoint · ESC pause
